site.name: microsoft-privacy
site.summary: microsoft-privacy-clone Clone of the Microsoft account privacy management panel and its sub-pages. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Main panel: top black Microsoft ribbon + account header (4-square logo + global nav + avatar); hero section with title and Privacy Checkup / Download / Privacy Statement entries; activity-data card grid (Browse / Search / Location / Voice / Media / Apps / Xbox / Ads — 8 cards total); privacy-settings toggle list (6 toggles with live "Saving…/Saved" feedback); two manage-data tiles (download / clear, clear has a modal second-confirmation); Microsoft product-level privacy entries (Windows / Xbox / Edge / Bing / Outlook / OneDrive / LinkedIn / M365) | | `browse-history.html` | Edge browse-history detail: breadcrumb, setting-status hint, filter bar (time range / device / search box), activity table (time / page title + URL / device / delete icon), per-row delete with animation, "Clear all" with modal confirmation, empty state | | `ad-settings.html` | Ad settings: master toggle (See ads that interest you) controls all sub-items; per-service cards (Microsoft / Bing & Edge / LinkedIn / Xbox) with independent toggles; multi-select intere

run_plan.goal: Exhaustively explore the Microsoft Privacy dashboard clone, focusing on settings toggles, data deletion flows, and the data download form across desktop and mobile viewports.
run_plan.summary: The exploration will start on the main privacy dashboard to verify global navigation and activity cards. It will then deep-dive into the Browse History page to test filtering and destructive actions (single/bulk delete). Next, the run will cover Ad Settings to validate complex toggle interactions and interest selection. Finally, it will walk through the multi-step Download Data form and re-test critical interactive flows on a mobile viewport.
assumptions: Settings toggles provide immediate visual feedback (e.g., 'Saving...' or state change) rather than requiring a separate submit button.
'Clear all' in browse history and 'Clear' in the dashboard trigger modal dialogs requiring secondary confirmation.
Form submission on download-data.html provides success feedback but doesn't actually trigger a file download.
risk_hotspots: The 'Clear all' modal dialog in browse-history.html and any corresponding dialog on index.html.
Interaction between the master 'See ads that interest you' toggle and the service-specific toggles in ad-settings.html.
Small tap targets in the global navigation and header, especially on mobile.

phases.title: Dashboard & Navigation
phases.objective: Verify the main dashboard layout, global navigation links, and activity card entry points.
key_checks: Check functionality of global header links and user menu.
Interact with top-level 'Privacy settings' toggles and observe feedback.
Verify that 'Manage browse activity' and 'Download your data' buttons route to correct sub-pages.
exit_criteria: Successfully navigated to browse-history.html, ad-settings.html, and download-data.html from the index.

phases.title: Browse History Management
phases.objective: Validate activity filtering and deletion interactions.
key_checks: Delete a single row using the per-row trash icon and observe animation/removal.
Click 'Clear all' and interact with the resulting modal confirmation.
exit_criteria: Filters manipulated, single row deleted, and 'Clear all' modal successfully confirmed or dismissed.

phases.title: Ad Personalization Settings
phases.objective: Test hierarchical toggle states and multi-select interactions.
key_checks: Toggle the master 'See ads that interest you' switch.
Toggle individual service switches (e.g., Microsoft consumer apps, Bing & Edge) and check dependency on master switch.
Select and deselect various 'Ad topics' checkboxes.
exit_criteria: Master toggle, sub-toggles, and interest checkboxes have been exercised and state changes verified.

phases.title: Data Download Flow
phases.objective: Complete the multi-step form to request a data archive.
key_checks: Select specific data categories (e.g., Account profile, Browse activity) instead of 'Include everything'.
Submit the form and observe success or validation states.

phases.title: Mobile Usability
phases.objective: Verify that complex layouts and dense navigation are usable on small screens.
key_checks: Check how the global navigation bar and 'small tap targets' adapt on mobile.
Verify that the activity card grid collapses properly on index.html.
Ensure data tables and filter bars in browse-history.html are usable without horizontal scrolling.
exit_criteria: Mobile layout assessed for overlap, horizontal scroll, and touch target size.

coverage_targets.features: Exercise settings toggles, modal dialogs, select dropdowns, and form submission.
coverage_targets.mobile: Re-run index navigation and browse history deletion flow on mobile viewport.

notes: Many small tap targets were flagged in the prescan; pay close attention to the top black ribbon and secondary nav usability, especially during the mobile phase.

observation.visible_text: Microsoft Support Software Devices Gaming Sign out Microsoft account Home Devices Subscriptions Payments & billing Privacy Security Rewards Order history Jack Wilson jack@outlook.com JW Privacy dashboard Review and manage the data Microsoft saves to make your experience better. You can view your activity, change privacy settings, or download a copy of your data at any time. Take the Privacy Checkup Download your data Privacy Statement Help with privacy Your activity data Some products and services save activity to your Microsoft account so it can sync across your devices. You can view and clear that data here. Browse history Microsoft Edge syncs the websites you visit so you can pick up where you left off across devices. 847 entries in the last 30 days Manage browse activity b Search history Bing remembers your searches to give you faster, more personal results next time you search. 312 searches in the last 30 days Manage search activity Location activity When location is on, your devices and Microsoft services can use your location to show local results. Last seen: Beijing, today 09:14 Manage location activity Voice activity When you talk to Microsoft, recordings can be saved and used to help improve voice recognition. Voice clip saving is off Manage voice activity Media activity Movies & TV from Microsoft Store, and music you play with Microsoft apps, are saved here. 23 items watched · 64 items played Manage media activity App and service activity Apps like Microsoft 365, OneDrive, and Teams save activity so they can work across your devices. 14 apps and services connected Manage app activity Xbox & gaming activity Games you play, achievements, and friends list contribute to your Xbox profile. Last played: Halo Infinite, May 8 Manage Xbox activity Ad settings Choose whether Microsoft uses your interests to show you more relevant ads in our apps and on the web. Personalized ads: On Manage ad settings Privacy settings Decide what Microsoft can save when you use our products. These settings apply across your devices when you’re signed in. Personalized ads Use my activity to show me ads that are more relevant. Turning this off won’t reduce how many ads I see. You can view your activity, change privacy settings, or download a copy of your data at any time. Take the Privacy Checkup Download your data Privacy Statement Help with privacy Your activity data Some products and services save activity to your Microsoft account so it can sync across your devices. You can view and clear that data here. Browse history Microsoft Edge syncs the websites you visit so you can pick up where you left off across devices. 847 entries in the last 30 days Manage browse activity b Search history Bing remembers your searches to give you faster, more personal results next time you search. 312 searches in the last 30 days Manage search activity Location activity When location is on, your devices and Microsoft services can use your location to show local results. Last seen: Beijing, today 09:14 Manage location activity Voice activity When you talk to Microsoft, recordings can be saved and used to help improve voice recognition. Voice clip saving is off Manage voice activity Media activity Movies & TV from Microsoft Store, and music you play with Microsoft apps, are saved here. 23 items watched · 64 items played Manage media activity App and service activity Apps like Microsoft 365, OneDrive, and Teams save activity so they can work across your devices. 14 apps and services connected Manage app activity Xbox & gaming activity Games you play, achievements, and friends list contribute to your Xbox profile. Last played: Halo Infinite, May 8 Manage Xbox activity Ad settings Choose whether Microsoft uses your interests to show you more relevant ads in our apps and on the web. Personalized ads: On Manage ad settings Privacy settings Decide what Microsoft can save when you use our products. These settings apply across your devices when you’re signed in. Let Microsoft use my location Show local weather, news, and search results based on where I am. Save voice recordings Help improve Microsoft voice recognition by letting us review samples. Personalized ads Use my activity to show me ads that are more relevant. Turning this off won’t reduce how many ads I see. Send diagnostic data Send extra diagnostic and usage data to help Microsoft improve our products. Changes save automatically.
